selection: Development validation only; preserve every attempted configuration; no optional extension or replacement of failed seeds.
competence: Preserve the existing conjunction of reward improvement and additional package displacement; evaluate separately from graph performance.
structural_stability: Report support selections, edge frequencies, Wilson intervals, pairwise Jaccard and conditional-edge-count null expectations. No claim of population stability from six runs alone.
competitive_refits: Use independent new training initializations after freezing support and baseline configurations. Same 524288-step environmental exposure; disclose algorithmic, memory, parameter and update differences.
budget_basis: Prospective engineering caps: four times prior screening duration, twice prior discovery initializations, sixteen times prior duration for calibrated baselines and competitive refits. Not a convergence guarantee. Full optimizer registry and resource preflight must be fixed before training.
